findings.rationale: Security group `admin` permits unrestricted TCP/22 ingress from `0.0.0.0/0`, exposing the administrative shell to any network client.
Security group `db` permits unrestricted TCP/3306 ingress from `0.0.0.0/0`, exposing the database engine to any network client.

findings.control: defense-in-depth: public access block neutralizes an anonymous grant
findings.rationale: The S3 bucket policy grants anonymous access, but the bucket public access block disables that route, so the exposure is contained rather than exploitable.
